children.title: Options
children.note: Hardware/feature options. Visibility of the sub-items is driven by the Option_* toggles (ParamID 32-36).

children.title: PConnector
children.subtitle: Applicator type selection
children.note: The applicator block lives on the MIO card. Four of its rows are repeated here for the Blow-On connector type - same ParamIDs, one value, two places to change it.

items.label: Apply Mode
items.note: New in the 2026-09-01 diagram. Same ParamID as on the MIO card; the show condition now reads "MIO2 = Applicator or PConnector = Blow-On".

links.why: The full applicator block, gated on MIO2 = Applicator

children.title: MIO-Card
children.subtitle: Signals & Applicator
children.note: Renamed and extended in the 2026-08-19 diagram: the card screen now also holds the complete applicator block. That answers the earlier open point - MIO2 Selection and the parameters it switches on now live on the same screen. Reachable from Machine > Options and from Interface > Digital IO.

items.label: MIO2 Selection
items.note: Options: Status / Applicator / Custom. Setting it to Applicator is what makes every row below visible.

links.why: Set up the applicator here, try it out there - today that is a five-step walk through the menu
The other half of the applicator setup

children.title: Bus- & Network Card
children.subtitle: *dynamic name
children.note: Marked "comes later" in the diagram. Shown as a disabled placeholder; the tile caption is generated at runtime from the detected card.

links.why: Roll and label geometry are usually set up together

children.title: Rewinder
children.note: Diagram note: to be defined for the D-Series, only visible for that machine type, enabled via the crypto chip information. So this is the first screen whose visibility depends on machine type rather than on a parameter - the design needs a rule for machine-type dependent tiles.

children.title: Start
children.shared: Also reachable via Digital IO > Sensors

items.label: Inhibit at Activate - queued
items.note: New in this version - not drawn in the diagram. Screen assignment to confirm.

items.label: Inhibit at Deactivate - queued
items.note: New in this version - not drawn in the diagram. Screen assignment to confirm.

children.title: Stop
children.shared: Also reachable via Digital IO > Sensors

items.label: Minimum Stop Input Pulse Length
items.note: No matching row in the Excel sheet.

items.label: Sensor Type
items.note: Three types planned at start: optical through-beam, capacitive, ultrasonic. Opt4-Opt10 are reserved IDs for later variants - see the report.

children.title: Digital IO
children.note: The diagram links Digital IO to Machine as well as to Interface. Same screen, two entry points.

children.title: Digital IO
children.note: Collects every IO-related block. Control, PConnector, the MIO card and Sensors are linked here in the diagram as well as under Machine > Options - same screens, second entry point.

children.title: Sensors
children.note: In the diagram the Start and Stop parameter blocks point to Sensors. Implemented as references to the same two screens.

children.title: Network
children.note: Collects every network service. The separate Webserver tile went in the previous version, the OPC UA tile in this one - OPC UA is two rows here now. Gateway Address and Easyplug Enable are new as well.

items.label: OPC UA Enable
items.note: New in the 2026-09-01 diagram. The separate OPC UA tile is gone.

items.label: Printfunction via CAN-Input
items.note: Linked parameter - same value as in Options > Printers.

items.label: Option CAN-Bus
items.note: Existed in an earlier file version and was removed - is the CAN option now covered by Enable External CAN alone?

children.title: Label
children.note: Overlaps strongly with Drive Unit > Start/Stop: 9 of 12 rows are the same ParamIDs. See the optimisation notes in the report.

links.why: Start carries the same Multi Label and Partial Label rows
Stop carries the same label length and missing label rows

items.label: Time
items.note: Type String with a number keypad - a time widget is still missing from the list of input field types.

items.label: Orientation
items.note: In the parameter list, but NOT on the HMI block of the 2026-09-01 diagram any more - and it grew from four to six options. Kept here because the parameter exists and drives the whole layout. Where should it live?

items.label: Device Name
items.note: New in this version, replaces the earlier "line name". Shown on the home screen.

items.label: Quicklink 1
items.note: Holds the ParamID of the parameter behind the home-screen shortcut.

children.title: Formats
children.note: Renamed from "Formats/Recipes" and restructured in the 2026-09-21 diagram: Save Format and the two Compare/Check screens are gone, Modify Format and Create New Format are new. All three are custom masks, not parameter lists.

links.why: Batch counter and the machine counters belong to the same question: how much has run

children.title: Information/Counters
children.note: Filled in the 2026-08-19 diagram. 20 rows on one screen - a candidate for a split into Information and Counters, see the optimisation notes.

items.label: Time since last Service
items.note: The parameter counts days, the diagram says "time" - agree on one.

children.title: Service
children.note: Changed in the 2026-08-19 diagram: "Parameter Overview (read only)" is gone and "User modified Parameters" moved up from Files to Service.

children.title: Diagnostic Function
children.note: The separate "Button/Switch Activate Diagnosis" screen is gone - the toggle now sits on the Diagnosis Logs screen.

children.title: Files
children.note: Both screens are the same USB file browser with different filters and different actions - one component, two configurations.

children.title: User modified Parameters
children.note: Moved from Files to Service. Diagram note: list of user modified parameters, can also be implemented in a later firmware update.

children.title: Users & Authentication
children.note: Three of the four screens are custom masks. The password policy is the only part that is a plain parameter list - and it now has real ParamIDs (618-627).

children.title: User Settings
children.subtitle: password policy
children.note: The only screen in this branch that is a plain parameter list - and as of list 10 every row has a ParamID.

children.title: Country Settings
children.src: not in the diagram - parameter CRA_relevant_Target_Country
children.note: Only in the parameter list, not drawn. Placed here because it decides which security rules apply. Type Boolean, although a target country is a selection.
